items: Mix flour, sugar, and margarine together until crumbly.
Press firmly into an ungreased 9x13 baking pan. Arrange pecans over crust.
Combine butter and brown sugar in a heavy sauce pan. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour over pecans. Bake at 350°F for 18 to 22 minutes or until bubbly.
Sprinkle with chocolate chips and spread when melted.
Cool completely and cut into small squares.
